caption: The drawing shows a sleeveless, high-collared vest depicted in two views: a detailed, colored front view on the left and a simple, uncolored line drawing of the back view on the right. The vest in the colored front view features a cream or light beige background and is adorned with small, repeating blue floral patterns arranged in rows. Two vertical bands of larger, more colorful flowers in pink, blue, and green run alongside the central opening down the front of the vest. The collar is upright with a gray interior, outlined in black. The vest has pointed, decorated flaps at the hips, edged in black and filled with the same pink and green floral design as the vertical front strips. The line drawing of the back view shows the vest’s outline with a high collar, a waist tie at the back, and the hip flaps indicated without color or pattern detail. The drawing is set on a plain, light beige background.
title: Waistcoat
